name: Avatar & handle
summary: Giving an agent a public identity: a name, a face, a social @handle and its own email address, so it can act in channels as itself rather than as the user. OpenClaw stores name, emoji and avatar in IDENTITY.md; services such as AgentMail issue inboxes to agents by API.
facts: OpenClaw (IDENTITY.md avatar), agent inbox APIs such as AgentMail
Clear separation from the user, but more accounts to manage
how: Pick a name and avatar and record them (e.g. IDENTITY.md)
Create channel accounts or bot users under that name
Give the agent its own inbox instead of the user's
Make it clear to others they are talking to an agent
goodFor: Keeping agent activity out of your personal accounts
watchOut: Platform terms may restrict automated accounts
Others should know they are dealing with an agent
